overview_description.description:
Lawdingo is an online service that provides remote-based paralegals and contract attorneys to law firms and to members of the public through partner law firms. No matter how small or large your firm is, their service provides a low-cost alternative to hiring in house full-time staff. Their belief has always been that legal services delivered online can increase your firm productivity in a highly efficient manner. Face to face interaction is usually not required, and online document sharing is well-established.

Their innovative web product allows you to connect with an appropriate legal professional, assign them work, share documents, deposit funds, and keep track of their hours.
